bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: 0.29x net debt/EBITDA, Altman Z 3.34, Piotroski 7, 8.51% YoY share-count reduction, 20% dividend hike, 10.88% FCF yield and 4.8x EV/EBITDA (below 5y median 5.7x and peer median 7.0x) mean no re-rating is needed to compound, and the Belarus-potash sell-off concerns potash not CF's nitrogen book (research/CF/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bull case).

target_band.cite: Valuation-anchor disagreement in the fact sheet's Valuation table: at TTM fundamentals, 5y-median P/E (10.0x) implies ~$134.9 and 5y-median EV/EBITDA (5.7x) implies ~$137.8, while 5y-median P/FCF (6.7x) implies only ~$84.5 because current P/FCF (9.2x) already sits above its own 5y maximum (120% of range) (research/CF/factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table). Half the $53.3 spread ($26.64) / $140 target = 0.1903; below the 0.3469 blended residual vol cap (research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: Base case: TTM operating margin (38.6%) and ROIC (24.5%) sit above every fiscal year except the FY2022 spike, a cyclical-peak signal, but the balance sheet (0.29x net debt/EBITDA) and buyback-driven 8.51% YoY share-count fall are genuine offsets, making partial (not full) margin reversion the modal path (research/CF/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case and Decision.scenarios.base.basis).

target_band.cite: Same valuation-anchor disagreement as the bull case (half-spread $26.64 from the fact sheet's Valuation table, research/CF/factsheet-2026-10-07.md) / $108 target = 0.2467; below the 0.3469 blended residual vol cap (research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case: Q2 2026 EPS $4.73 missed consensus $5.44 and revenue $2.22B missed $2.44B (research/CF/factsheet-2026-10-07.md News & sentiment, TheFly 2026-08-05); FCF margin fell from 36.1% to 24.7% and FCF/NI from 257% to 91% as Blue Point capex rises before 2029 output, and P/FCF (9.2x) and P/B (3.1x) both sit above their own 5y maximum (research/CF/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case).

expected_12m_move.cite: Factor news for SPY is mixed: record-high headlines driven narrowly by a handful of AI/megacap names (CNBC, MarketWatch 2026-10-06: 'S&P 500 Hits a New Record High, Powered by Tech-and Not Much Else') alongside explicit caution on 'rate chaos and narrow breadth' (MarketWatch 2026-10-06) and overbought megacaps (Barrons 2026-10-06); no clear net direction, so 0 (research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json factor_news.SPY). Macro overlay also treats this as background context, not a thesis driver (research/CF/2026-10-07-macro.md).

Factor news for IEF is mixed/conflicting day to day: a deepening global bond rout and 10y yields at a 2002 high (WSJ, Bloomberg 2026-10-01; Barrons 2026-10-05 on France-led selloff) versus Treasury yields easing from multi-year peaks the same week (Bloomberg, Invezz 2026-10-02/10-06); no clear net direction, so 0 (research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json factor_news.IEF). Macro overlay states CF's thesis is not driven by rates/the dollar (research/CF/2026-10-07-macro.md).

jumps.reason: CF reported Q2 2026 EPS $4.73 vs consensus $5.44 and revenue $2.22B vs consensus $2.44B, a discrete earnings-release risk that recurs every quarter
jumps.cite: research/CF/factsheet-2026-10-07.md News & sentiment (TheFly, 2026-08-05); research/CF/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case

annual_probability.cite: Of the 20 quarterly earnings-release weeks in the 5-year history (research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks), 6 produced a weekly move of -5% or worse (2023-02-13 -0.0857, 2024-04-29 -0.0739, 2025-02-18 -0.0555, 2025-08-04 -0.1163, 2026-05-04 -0.0625, 2026-08-03 -0.0866), i.e. a severe adverse earnings reaction occurs about 0.30x/year

impact.cite: analogue week 2026-08-03 (Q2 2026 earnings release), move -0.0866, research/CF/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks
